notes: «ثم ذكر كلمة معناها حدثنا شعبة» is the compiler's note that a word meaning «haddathana» was skipped; «شعبة» is still the next name written.
«محمد» is a bare name here, not identified.
Shu'ba's own remark «قال شعبة فأحفظ» concerns what he remembers about the wording; it is not a route and is left out.
«جدتي، وهي أم عمارة بنت كعب»: the relation word is followed by the name, so one link (rule 7).
